properties.label: Mateur · Ichkeul plain
properties.description: A lowland window centred on the Mateur railway station. The surrounding plain also contains the protected lake and marshes of Ichkeul.

evidence.title: Parc National de l'Ichkeul
evidence.organization: Tunisian National Agency for Environmental Protection
evidence.limitation: The agency describes the protected wetland. Its account does not establish the park boundary, environmental releases or farm allocations inside this window.

source.name: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200
source.attribution: © ESA WorldCover project 2021 / Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2021) processed by ESA WorldCover consortium
source.coverage: Categorical 10 m land cover in the profile window. The 3D texture shows the dominant class in each coarser cell. Class shares use the original valid pixels, including water.

source.name: NASA POWER daily
source.coverage: MERRA-2 and SYN1DEG gridded data for the requested point. UTC complete-day means for temperature and irradiance, precipitation summed over the same days.

location_source.name: Study-window reference point
location_source.coverage: Reference point for an approximately 10 × 10 km evidence window. The window is not a cadastral or study-area boundary.

water_question: Which seasonal water commitments must be checked before scheduling an additional diversion on the Mateur plain?
